TextView.android:text: Audiobook (optional)

One Spotify audiobook, reached through its own book-shaped button instead of the playlist button above. Paste its link from the Spotify app (Share → Copy Link) and give it a name. A shortened spotify.link address works too - the app will follow it to find the real audiobook link.

This tablet isn't provisioned as this app's device owner, so it doesn't lock itself down automatically. If you ever get stuck on the home screen, long-press the gear icon in the top right, then Restart App - that one never needs the Family PIN. Tablet Settings and Family Setup do need the PIN, if one is set.
